triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '3. Using PyTorch or Wall-Clock Time as Performance Baseline' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 3. Using PyTorch or Wall-Clock Time as Performance Baseline

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL Chunk-GDN Wave-Specialized Megakernel on MI308X -- 3. Using PyTorch or Wall-Clock Time as Performance Baseline

payload.attempted: For the convenience of standalone operators, using PyTorch references, manual timing, `torch.cuda.Event`, or `do_bench` to assess gains.
payload.lesson: PyTorch is only used for correctness. The performance table must clearly list which dispatches from the rocprofv3 kernel trace are summed.

established_fact.mechanism: The fair boundary for this megakernel is the back half after `a/g_cumsum` has been precomputed. Triton is only the same-boundary comparison baseline here: `recompute_w_u_fwd + fwd_h + fwd_o`. Performance conclusions can only be read from the kernel dispatch duration of `rocprofv3 --kernel-trace`.

payload.observed: The performance boundary is unfair, easily miscounting input construction, front half, synchronization, or benchmark overhead into kernel gains.
